data.body: Plan-readiness checkpoint: confirmed the uv bootstrap mismatch on origin/main@4c994034 and reused existing bug foliated-correct-arcticfox. Independent parent audit passed five story plans and identified two minimal defects. Remediated rubbery-glacial-cowbird to make migration proof a completion target, tie semantic ACs to leaf-linked non-author TSV rows, and require concrete Gerrit/merged-main receipts. Remediated dendritic-irksome-raven from stale 11-leaf/impossible pre-claim wording to its 12-leaf, pre-review command-manifest sequence. Exact CLI readback confirmed the rejected phrases are absent and replacement evidence is present. MCP edit returned HTTP 502 before delivery; repo-venv CLI fallback performed both edits.
